title: Papeleria document manifest
description: A printable document in the kit's project-report style, schema version 1: a takeaway title, labelled metadata, at least one section of blocks, and an optional source note. A section can start a new sheet; every section heading is a deep link. Video is allowed here, and only here.

schema.description: The manifest format this piece is written for. Write 1. A missing, non-integer or smaller value is a manifest error; a larger one needs a newer Papeleria.

template.description: Which template builds this piece. This schema describes the document template, so the value is document.

title.description: The document's takeaway: the one sentence the reader should leave with. Inline Markdown.

language.description: en (the default) or es. Sets the page language and chooses English or Spanish control labels. The editor itself stays English.

status.description: draft (the default), review, published or withheld. It is shown on the piece. published turns an unfilled [placeholder] into an error; withheld builds a private preview and writes nothing to dist/.

wordmark.description: The wordmark text for this piece. Leave it out to use the theme's, papeleria unless the owner has set another.

credits.description: The credits for the document, shown with its metadata.

doc_type.description: The label at the top of each sheet, such as Project report. It defaults to Document, or Documento when the language is es.

metadata.description: Labelled facts shown under the title, such as Audience, Owner, Period and Version, in the order written.

sections.description: The sections in order: at least one and at most 1,000. Each heading's slug is the section's deep link, such as #hours-by-phase.

source_note.description: Small print after the last section, such as the basis of the figures. Markdown written here or loaded from assets/text/.

footer.description: Footer text at the end of each logical sheet. The piece's status stays visible with it; no physical page number or total is generated.

section.description: One section: a heading followed by at least one block. Any block kind is allowed, including video.

heading.description: The section heading. Its slug becomes the section's deep link; a repeated heading gets -2, -3 in order.

new_page.description: Set to true to start this section on a new sheet on screen and a new page in print. Long content still flows on to further pages rather than being cut.

blocks.description: The blocks of this section, in reading order: text, image, video, chart, table, quote, note, callout or logo.
